title: Label smoothing hurts perplexity while improving BLEU
description: Label smoothing during training makes the model less confident, which hurts perplexity but improves accuracy and BLEU score.
canonical_description: label smoothing degrades perplexity while improving task accuracy

evidence.quote: This hurts perplexity, as the model learns to be more unsure, but improves accuracy and BLEU score.
